description:
My life... Where did it all go wrong?  
In this short life, I can't blame others,  
Just tumbling and rolling through various ups and downs,  
A man, 'Seong Ji-hwan,' who faced a futile death, worn out by stress.

Fortunately (or unfortunately?), he was reborn as the protagonist of the cliché 'rebirth' genre...  
Huh? My boring reality remains the same!?  
All I can do is 'not do' anything!

It can't be helped,  
At least, I'll cut ties with the trash that only hindered my life!  
It may be too trivial to call it a superpower...  
Can this alone change my life?

"We were dirty together, but let's not meet again in this life!"
